title: Additional written application 1
prompt: Species of polyploid coffee plants are known. Calculate the diploid, tetraploid, and octoploid number of chromosomes for this species if its haploid number is 11 chromosomes. Show the calculation or sequence and explain your reasoning. Use only the supplied evidence; do not invent observations.

stimuli.alt: Original question diagram or data. Use its labels and values with the written directions.

title: Additional written application 2
prompt: The major events in spermatogenesis in human males are listed below. These events are not necessarily in the correct order. 1. meiosis II 2. spermatids 3. spermatogonium 4. meiosis I 5. primary spermatocytes 6. secondary spermatocytes The correct sequence in the production of sperm is _____, _____, _____, _____, _____, and _____. Show the calculation or sequence and explain your reasoning. Use only the supplied evidence; do not invent observations.
